_comment: READ THIS FIRST - NOT a real announcement. The site ignores any entry without an id and title, so this guide entry never shows as a banner. JSON files cannot have // comments, so notes live in fields starting with _ instead. Full guide: ANNOUNCEMENTS.md in this same folder.
_to_add: Copy a real entry below, paste it after the last one (with a comma between entries), then change: id (must be NEW and unique, e.g. 2026-12-water-shutoff), severity, title, details, expiresAt. Commit on GitHub, check the preview link in about 60 seconds.
_to_remove: Delete the whole real entry, OR set its expiresAt to a date in the past. Do NOT rely on the X button on the site - that only hides it on one person's phone/computer.
_severity: urgent = water shutoff, towing, safety, pavilion closed today. Cannot be fully dismissed - X collapses it to a '1 Urgent Alert' pill. important = annual meeting, dues change, election. info = maintenance next week, new vendor, trash delay. Important/info CAN be dismissed on that device.
_title: Keep the title under 80 characters - it is the one line on the banner. Put the full text in details.
_expiresAt: Always set one, Eastern time, e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59-05:00. After that date/time the banner hides itself automatically.
_template: { "id": "2026-12-your-topic", "severity": "important", "title": "Short headline under 80 characters.", "details": "Full text shown when someone taps Details - one or two sentences, plus what to do.", "actionLabel": "View Parking Map", "actionHref": "#guide", "expiresAt": "2026-12-31T23:59:59-05:00" }

title: Common-area irrigation winterization & mulch refresh scheduled Nov 30 – Dec 2.
details: Landscaping crews will blow out common-area irrigation lines and refresh pine-needle beds along Trout Lily Drive and Autumn Olive Drive between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM. Please keep alleyways and guest parking aprons clear during work hours.
